## Problem and resulting behavior
Explain the problem this change solves and what now happens.

## Related issue
Link the issue, or state that this is a standalone change.

## Validation
Record commands or scenarios, actual outcomes, and checks not run. Separate simulated tests from real-model evaluations.

## Integration impact
Identify affected fields, schema versions, migrations, configuration, or teammate modules. Write none if there is no integration impact.

## Review
Requested reviewer:
Remaining work or limitations:

- [ ] Scope matches the described change.
- [ ] Appropriate validation results are recorded.
- [ ] Shared contract changes were reviewed by affected teammates, or no contract changed.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and examples are updated.
